rca_of_issue.asc_mc_repair: Root cause was timezone resolution falling back to +08:00 default when timezone_iana was null in astrology.metadata. Repair endpoint forced timezone_override='America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' which recomputed correct UTC (1983-05-03T11:05:00+00:00) and triggered chart recomputation. ASC/MC now align with GM signs.
rca_of_issue.legacy_migration_info_residue: Top-level user.migration_info is a stale side-table written by an older migration pass. The current repair endpoint only updates astrology.metadata; nothing rewrites the legacy top-level keys. Cosmetic and does not affect rendered chart, but visible via peek_chart_angles. Mitigation: extend repair_chart_for_user to also overwrite the legacy keys.
rca_of_issue.sun_moon_gm_delta: Reproducible. Mirror returns sidereal 13-sign positions (Sun Aries 11.41° lon 11.41, Moon Sag 27.21° lon 262.99) with SVP=31.2836. GM appears tropical 12-sign (Sun Taurus 14.13, Moon Aries 0.22). Sun aligns on tropical scale within ~1.4°. Moon however is ~66° off even after SVP correction — exceeds the 15-min birth_time uncertainty (≈3.3°). Hypothesis: GM is computed at a materially different time (e.g., 08:20 local treated differently, or a different timezone interpretation by GM) OR Mirror's Moon ephemeris has a sign-level bug. Engine inspection of /app/backend/calculations/astrology.py is recommended before declaring 'convention difference'.
